name: grill-vo-1
text: Every Indian balcony is a cage. On purpose. Look up on any street. Iron grills, floor to ceiling. Families put them up after burglaries. Safety, right? Here's what fire officers keep warning. [pause] A grill that keeps thieves out... can also keep you in. September 2021, Bengaluru. A fire in an apartment complex. Two people were trapped on a grilled balcony, and lost their lives. The next day, the city told residents: no balcony grills without its approval. Mumbai's fire chief has a simple fix. Keep the grill, but make it open, with a lock you can break in an emergency. So look at your balcony... can your cage open?
